newsitem.title: UK: UK trade data show competitive strength-Treasury.
newsitem.headline: UK trade data show competitive strength-Treasury.

text.p: Trade data published today show the competitive strength of the UK economy, Treasury minister Angela Knight said in a statement.
"This is another set of figures confirming the competitive strength of the UK economy...UK exporters are in an ideal position to benefit from the upturn in our key European markets," she said.
UK JULY GLOBAL TRADE DEFICIT 1.23 BLN STG, EX-OIL ERRATICS 1.79 BLN STG
UK JULY EU TRADE DEFICIT 541 MLN STG, GLOBAL TREND FLAT
UK AUGUST NON-EU TRADE DEFICIT 499 MLN STG, EX-OIL ERRATICS 536 MLN STG
